title: Reductive Quotient of a Self-Dual Lattice Function
body_html:
Reductive Quotient of a Self-Dual Lattice Function

For a self-dual lattice function \(L\), the finite quotient \[ G_L/G_{L,0+} \] decomposes as a product of unitary factors at the self-dual jumps and general linear factors paired across opposite jumps. In the notation of the source, this is the product involving \(G_0\), \(G_{\nu_D/2}\), and \(\operatorname{GL}(L_r)\) for positive jumps \(r\) below \(\nu_D/2\).
proof_html: The proof is standard in the source. The apartment fractional decomposition identifies \(V^r/V^rp_K\) with \(L_r/L_{r+}\), pairs \(r\) with \(-r\), and then reads off the unitary self-dual factors and paired general linear factors.
